package.name: amr_common
package.description:
The things every other package needs and nobody should write twice: the pose maths, and the names of the topics the nodes talk over.
It exists because quaternion to yaw was written twelve times across ten files in TWO MATHEMATICALLY INEQUIVALENT FORMS, and because the controller name appears in five Python files and several YAML files with nothing keeping them in step. A subscriber to a topic that no longer exists does not error, it just goes quiet, so renaming the controller broke nodes silently. Both problems are shapes rather than bugs, and a shared package is the only fix that stops the next instance.
